281	const MONTHS = [
282		'January',
283		'February',
284		'March',

296	/** '2026-04' → 'April 2026' */
297	export const formatMonth = (ym: string) => {
298		const [year, month] = ym.split('-').map(Number);
299		return `${MONTHS[month - 1]} ${year}`;
300	};
301	
302	export const formatRange = (start: string, end?: string) =>
303		`${formatMonth(start)} – ${end ? formatMonth(end) : 'Present'}`;
304	
305	/** Inclusive month count → '1 yr 3 mos'. Open-ended roles count up to `now`. */
306	export const formatDuration = (start: string, end?: string, now = new Date()) => {
307		const [sy, sm] = start.split('-').map(Number);
308		const [ey, em] = end ? end.split('-').map(Number) : [now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1];
309		const total = (ey - sy) * 12 + (em - sm) + 1;
310		const years = Math.floor(total / 12);
311		const months = total % 12;
312		const part = (n: number, unit: string) => (n ? `${n} ${unit}${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}` : '');
313		return [part(years, 'yr'), part(months, 'mo')].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '1 mo';
314	};
315	
316	export const inlineToText = (inline: Inline) =>
317		inline.map((run) => (typeof run === 'string' ? run : 'strong' in run ? run.strong : run.text)).join('');
318	
319	const inlineToMarkdown = (inline: Inline) =>
320		inline
321			.map((run) =>
322				typeof run === 'string' ? run : 'strong' in run ? `**${run.strong}**` : `[${run.text}](${run.href})`
323			)
324			.join('');
325	
326	const mdLink = (text: string, href?: string) => (href ? `[${text}](${href})` : text);

328	export function resumeToMarkdown() {
329		const r = RESUME;
330		const lines: string[] = [
331			`# ${r.name}`,
332			'',
333			`${r.label} · ${r.location.label}`,
334			'',
335			...r.links.map((link) => `- ${link.network ?? 'Website'}: [${link.label}](${link.href})`),
336			`- Email: [${r.email}](mailto:${r.email})`,
337			`- PDF: ${SITE_URL}${RESUME_PDF_PATH}`,
338			'',
339			'## Summary',
340			'',
341			r.summary,
342			'',
343			'## Experience',
344		];
345	
346		for (const role of r.experience) {
347			lines.push(
348				'',
349				`### ${role.title} · ${mdLink(role.company, role.companyUrl)}`,
350				'',
351				`*${formatRange(role.start, role.end)} · ${role.location}* — ${role.stack.join(', ')}`,
352				'',
353				...role.highlights.map((h) => `- ${inlineToMarkdown(h)}`)
354			);
355		}
356	
357		lines.push('', '## Skills', '', ...r.skills.map((group) => `- **${group.name}:** ${group.keywords.join(', ')}`));
358	
359		lines.push('', '## Open Source');
360		for (const project of r.openSource) {
361			const link = project.link ? ` — ${mdLink(project.link.text, project.link.href)}` : '';
362			lines.push('', `### ${project.name}${link}`, '', ...project.highlights.map((h) => `- ${inlineToMarkdown(h)}`));
363		}
364	
365		lines.push('', '## Education');
366		for (const edu of r.education) {
367			lines.push(
368				'',
369				`### ${mdLink(edu.institution, edu.url)}`,
370				'',
371				`${edu.studyType} in ${edu.area} · ${formatRange(edu.start, edu.end)} · ${edu.score}`
372			);
373		}
374	
375		return `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
376	}

378	/** JSON Resume (https://jsonresume.org/schema) */
379	export function resumeToJsonResume() {
380		const r = RESUME;
381		return {
382			$schema: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsonresume/resume-schema/v1.0.0/schema.json',
383			basics: {
384				name: r.name,
385				label: r.label,
386				email: r.email,
387				url: SITE_URL,
388				summary: r.summary,
389				location: { countryCode: r.location.countryCode },
390				profiles: r.links
391					.filter((link) => link.network)
392					.map((link) => ({
393						network: link.network,
394						username: link.label.split('/')[1],
395						url: link.href,
396					})),
397			},
398			work: r.experience.map((role) => ({
399				name: role.company,
400				...(role.companyUrl ? { url: role.companyUrl } : {}),
401				position: role.title,
402				location: role.location,
403				startDate: role.start,
404				...(role.end ? { endDate: role.end } : {}),
405				highlights: role.highlights.map(inlineToText),
406			})),
407			education: r.education.map((edu) => ({
408				institution: edu.institution,
409				url: edu.url,
410				area: edu.area,
411				studyType: edu.studyType,
412				startDate: edu.start,
413				endDate: edu.end,
414				score: edu.score,
415			})),
416			skills: r.skills,
417			projects: r.openSource.map((project) => ({
418				name: project.name,
419				highlights: project.highlights.map(inlineToText),
420				...(project.link ? { url: project.link.href } : {}),
421			})),
422			meta: {
423				canonical: `${SITE_URL}${RESUME_JSON_PATH}`,
424				version: 'v1.0.0',
425			},
426		};
427	}
428	
429	export const PERSON_ID = `${SITE_URL}/#person`;
430	
431	/** schema.org ProfilePage → Person, for search engines and agents reading the page. */
432	export function resumeToJsonLd() {
433		const r = RESUME;
434		const current = r.experience.find((role) => !role.end);
435		const org = (name: string, url?: string) => ({ '@type': 'Organization', name, ...(url ? { url } : {}) });
436		const pastEmployers = r.experience.filter(
437			(role, i, all) =>
438				role.end && role.company !== current?.company && all.findIndex((x) => x.company === role.company) === i
439		);
440	
441		return {
442			'@context': 'https://schema.org',
443			'@type': 'ProfilePage',
444			'@id': `${SITE_URL}/resume`,
445			url: `${SITE_URL}/resume`,
446			name: `${r.name} — Resume`,
447			mainEntity: {
448				'@type': 'Person',
449				'@id': PERSON_ID,
450				name: r.name,
451				url: SITE_URL,
452				email: `mailto:${r.email}`,
453				jobTitle: r.label,
454				description: r.summary,
455				nationality: { '@type': 'Country', name: r.location.country },
456				sameAs: [...r.links.filter((link) => link.network).map((link) => link.href), 'https://x.com/okshubhh'],
457				...(current ? { worksFor: org(current.company, current.companyUrl) } : {}),
458				alumniOf: [
459					...r.education.map((edu) => ({ '@type': 'CollegeOrUniversity', name: edu.institution, url: edu.url })),
460					...pastEmployers.map((role) => org(role.company, role.companyUrl)),
461				],
462				hasCredential: r.education.map((edu) => ({
463					'@type': 'EducationalOccupationalCredential',
464					credentialCategory: 'degree',
465					name: `${edu.studyType} in ${edu.area}`,
466					recognizedBy: { '@type': 'CollegeOrUniversity', name: edu.institution },
467				})),
468				hasOccupation: {
469					'@type': 'Occupation',
470					name: r.label,
471					skills: r.skills.flatMap((group) => group.keywords).join(', '),
472				},
473				knowsAbout: r.skills.flatMap((group) => group.keywords),
474			},
475		};
476	}
